# Source:reset

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Reset the source (Flight / Timer / Telemetry)

```lua
source:reset()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
source1 = system.getSource("ALT")
source1:reset()
source2 = system.getSource({category=CATEGORY_TIMER, member=0})
source2:reset()
```
